newsitem.title: USA: U.S. July light vehicle sales rise 4.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: U.S. July light vehicle sales rise 4.5 percent.

text.p: U.S. car and light truck sales during the month of July totaled 1,358,818 units with all major automakers reporting, a 4.5 percent increase from the 1,299,791 units sold a year earlier.

New seasonal adjustment factors from the U.S. Commerce Department were not yet available for July, but using last year's factors, the seasonally adjusted annual sales rate (SAAR) comes to 15.5 million units, compared with 14.7 million a year earlier and a 14.3 million annual rate in June.
The SAAR for July was the best since March, when the industry sales rate reached a strong rate of 15.8 million units.
